findings.title: Committed governance result is invalid YAML
findings.body: Exact R HG-056.yaml line 405 contains an unquoted limitation with colon-space after 9650c791. yaml.safe_load interprets a mapping and raises ScannerError at lines 406-407 (continuation lacks a mapping colon). The result cannot parse or satisfy HARNESS_CHANGE.schema.json. This is a new concrete result defect, independently reproduced and acknowledged by root, distinct from the external unmet gates.

Do not repair the result through REVIEW_RECORD_ONLY or normalize it during validation.
